taxes.statute: Liberia Revenue Code 2000 as amended to 2020 s. 3 (c)-(d) and s. 4 (world/B10-anglophone-africa/lr/law/REVENUE-CODE-LIBERIA-REVENUE-CODE-AMENDEMENT-2020-min.txt); Tax Amendment Acts 2024 and the LRC Amendment of December 2025 (OCR) add no stamp or transfer duty
taxes.why: LR: no stamp duty or transfer duty. LRC s. 4 lists the taxes in effect (income tax and royalties, GST, excise, customs duties, real property tax, government agency fees); s. 3 (c)-(d): all changes to taxation are made by amendments to the Code and taxation may not be included in non-tax legislation. Chapter 20 (real property tax) s. 2005 only requires registrars of deeds to report conveyances. Deed registration and probate charges are fees, not modelled.

taxes.tax: Withholding on interest, dividends and rent paid to residents
taxes.classification: duplicate (collection of the personal income tax)
taxes.oecdGuide: OECD Interpretative Guide (Revenue Statistics 2026, Annex A; R4/fetch/gap/oecd_guide.txt) §30 ('The way that a tax is levied or collected ... does not affect classification') and §28 (heading 1100)
taxes.why: Liberia Revenue Code (as amended 2020) s. 905 (b) (15 % on non-exempt interest and dividends paid to residents) and s. 905 (d) (10 % on rent of 70 000 or more a year) are withholdings with no finality provision in the Code: they are credited against the resident's personal income tax, so the tax is the personal income tax (1100) on that income, computed by the 1.x model, collected in part at source. Not a separate tax.
taxes.was: grade C (s. 905(b): 15 % on non-exempt interest and dividends paid to residents; s. 905(d): 10 % on rent where annual rent is 70 000 or more — the Code makes neither withholding final (no finality provision fo)
